content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional payment platforms are restricted, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-2|How a]]s-ghana-get-paid-online-trap-most-5|creators]] face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-explained-digital-creators-6|COREMERCH guide to selling]] their products online. With Stripe and PayPal unavailable, the need for a sovereign commerce infrastructure has never been more pressing. This is where COREMERCH comes in, offering a range of solutions, including Stack 01 and Stack 02, to help creators build and deploy their own digital stores on platforms like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to COREMERCH's success lies in its ability to provide a decentralized and autonomous commerce infrastructure. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can maintain full control over their stores. This infrastructure is not only more secure but also more reliable, as it is not dependent on any single platform or service.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to have a clear understanding of your products and target audience. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will enable you to accept cryptocurrency payments. Additionally, you'll need to choose between Stack 01 and Stack 02, depending on your specific needs and requirements. Stack 01 is a more basic solution, while Stack 02 offers more advanced features and support.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
Deploy your digital store in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and scales, you'll need to ensure that your infrastructure can keep up. This may involve upgrading to a more advanced plan, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, or optimizing your store for better performance. With COREMERCH's guidance, you'll be able to navigate the scaling process with confidence and ensure that your store continues to run smoothly and efficiently.

Stack 01 is a more basic solution that can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 is a more advanced solution that is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours and includes end-to-end testing and configuration of SPF/DKIM/DMARC.

For creators looking to build a digital store that accepts crypto payments, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a great option. This solution includes deployment of Stack 02 in 48 hours, as well as end-to-end testing and configuration of SPF/DKIM/DMARC. You can learn more about this solution and others on the COREMERCH website, https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by setting up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, set up your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, integrate NOWPayments with your store and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Finally, test your store and go live, ensuring that you have a smooth and efficient customer experience.
